name: Summer Meals for Kids
description: Free summer meals for children 18 and under at community sites - no paperwork required at most sites
fullDescription: Free summer meals are available for children and teens 18 and under at schools, parks, libraries, and community sites throughout the Bay Area when school is out.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free breakfast and/or lunch
- No registration required at most open sites
- No income verification at open sites
- Available at parks, libraries, schools, community centers
- Open to children 18 and under
howToGetIt:
1. Check the California Department of Education's Summer Meal Service Sites list (updated each summer)
2. Or use the CA Meals for Kids mobile app to find nearby sites
3. Check site days and meal times before you go
4. At most open sites, just show up - no paperwork required
5. Sites operate during summer vacation and other school breaks
keywords: summer meals, free lunch, summer food, kids meals, summer feeding, SFSP, children, no school
